description: This file appears to be a core implementation of Git's notes management system, including data structures and functions for handling notes trees, loading, saving, and manipulating notes and non-note objects, and configuration handling related to Git notes.

classes.name: int_node
classes.description: Internal node in the notes tree with a fixed array of child pointers.

classes.name: leaf_node
classes.description: Leaf node in the notes tree containing object IDs as key-value pairs.

classes.name: non_note
classes.description: Structure representing non-note objects in a notes tree, stored in a linked list.

classes.name: tree_write_stack
classes.description: Stack structure for managing tree writing process, including buffers for serialization.

classes.name: write_each_note_data
classes.description: Context data used during notes serialization to write tree objects and non-note entries.

classes.name: note_delete_list
classes.description: Linked list node used to keep track of notes to be deleted.

classes.name: display_notes_opt
classes.description: Options structure for managing display of notes references.

methods.name: void ** note_tree_search(struct notes_tree * t,struct int_node ** tree,unsigned char * n,const unsigned char * key_sha1)
methods.description: Recursively search the notes tree for a position for a given key.

methods.name: struct:leaf_node * note_tree_find(struct notes_tree * t,struct int_node * tree,unsigned char n,const unsigned char * key_sha1)
methods.description: Find a note entry matching a specific key.

methods.name: int note_tree_consolidate(struct int_node * tree,struct int_node * parent,unsigned char index)
methods.description: Consolidate internal nodes with only one child into a single node.

methods.name: void note_tree_remove(struct notes_tree * t,struct int_node * tree,unsigned char n,struct leaf_node * entry)
methods.description: Remove a note entry from the notes tree.

methods.name: int note_tree_insert(struct notes_tree * t,struct int_node * tree,unsigned char n,struct leaf_node * entry,unsigned char type,combine_notes_fn combine_notes)
methods.description: Insert a new note or subtree into the notes tree.

methods.name: void note_tree_free(struct int_node * tree)
methods.description: Free all memory associated with a notes tree.

methods.name: void load_subtree(struct notes_tree * t,struct leaf_node * subtree,struct int_node * node,unsigned int n)
methods.description: Load a subtree of notes from a tree object into the in-memory data structures.

methods.name: unsigned char determine_fanout(struct int_node * tree,unsigned char n,unsigned char fanout)
methods.description: Decide the on-disk fanout layout for notes based on the current tree level.

methods.name: void construct_path_with_fanout(const unsigned char * hash,unsigned char fanout,char * path)
methods.description: Generate a path string with fanout directory structure based on hash.

methods.name: int for_each_note_helper(struct notes_tree * t,struct int_node * tree,unsigned char n,unsigned char fanout,int flags,each_note_fn fn,void * cb_data)
methods.description: Traverse the notes tree and apply a callback to each note/subtree.

methods.name: void write_tree_entry(struct strbuf * buf,unsigned int mode,const char * path,unsigned int path_len,const unsigned char * hash)
methods.description: Write a single tree entry line into a buffer for serialization.

methods.name: void tree_write_stack_init_subtree(struct tree_write_stack * tws,const char * path)
methods.description: Initialize a subtree in the tree write stack.

methods.name: int tree_write_stack_finish_subtree(struct tree_write_stack * tws)
methods.description: Finalize and write out a subtree from the stack.

methods.name: int write_each_note_helper(struct tree_write_stack * tws,const char * path,unsigned int mode,const struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Serialize each note and subtree into a tree object.

methods.name: void format_note(struct notes_tree * t,const struct object_id * object_oid,struct strbuf * sb,const char * output_encoding,int raw)
methods.description: Retrieve and format a note message for display.

methods.name: void format_display_notes(const struct object_id * object_oid,struct strbuf * sb,const char * output_encoding,int raw)
methods.description: Combine and format notes for display from multiple notes trees.

methods.name: int add_note(struct notes_tree * t,const struct object_id * object_oid,const struct object_id * note_oid,combine_notes_fn combine_notes)
methods.description: Add a note associated with an object ID in a notes tree.

methods.name: int remove_note(struct notes_tree * t,const unsigned char * object_sha1)
methods.description: Remove a note associated with an object ID.

methods.name: const struct object_id * get_note(struct notes_tree * t,const struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Retrieve the note object ID for a given object ID.

methods.name: int for_each_note(struct notes_tree * t,int flags,each_note_fn fn,void * cb_data)
methods.description: Iterate over all notes and apply a callback.

methods.name: int write_notes_tree(struct notes_tree * t,struct object_id * result)
methods.description: Serialize the entire notes tree into a set of tree objects.

methods.name: void prune_notes(struct notes_tree * t,int flags)

methods.name: void free_notes(struct notes_tree * t)
methods.description: Free all memory used by a notes structure.
